current_state_audit.finding: Coverage is heavily skewed to Website/UX/CRO/Analytics (≈50% of all posts) despite that being only 1 of 11 Money Pages. Chatbot AI and Automation — 2 of the 5 areas this audit was asked to cover — have essentially no informational (TOFU/MOFU) support: 1 post and 2 posts respectively, and in both cases the post is itself a service-pitch duplicate of the Money Page rather than genuine supporting content.
current_state_audit.orphan_risk: None of the 29 posts are structurally orphaned (global /news index + nav links to /news), but 6 of them are 'service pitch' posts (title starts with 'Dịch vụ ...') that duplicate a Money Page's own primary keyword and framing rather than supporting it â€” see cannibalization_findings.

competing_urls: news:"Dịch vụ quay chụp sản phẩm chuyên nghiệp"
news:"Quay Video, chụp hình làm nội dung chuyên nghiệp..."
cannibalization_findings.keyword_overlap: quay chụp sản phẩm / quay video sản phẩm / chụp ảnh sản phẩm / sản xuất video quảng cáo / bảng giá quay chụp
cannibalization_findings.root_cause: /product-photography's own live title+description ('Quay chụp sản phẩm và thương hiệu' / 'Quay phim, chụp ảnh sản phẩm, không gian...') already claims video production language that belongs to /photography-video ('sản xuất video quảng cáo'). /media-pricing then adds a third URL selling 17 packages across 8 groups spanning both photo AND video ('Bảng giá quay chụp & sản xuất Media'). Two live blog posts duplicate this again at the informational layer: post #1 is a generic 'video + photo' overview, post #13 ('Dịch vụ quay chụp sản phẩm chuyên nghiệp') near-exactly restates /product-photography's own primary keyword with a 'Dịch vụ' (service-pitch) framing — i.e. a blog post competing head-to-head with its own Money Page.
cannibalization_findings.serp_evidence: Real WebSearch sampling (2026-08-24) shows the Vietnamese market itself treats 'quay video sản phẩm' and 'chụp ảnh sản phẩm' as two distinct SERP clusters (different ranking domains: mona.media/dich-vu-quay-video-san-pham, viet-power.vn, sanxuattvc.vn for video vs. mona.media/chup-anh-san-pham, sikido.vn, sotagroup.vn for photo) — only mona.media ranks for both, via two SEPARATE URLs. The combined query 'quay chụp sản phẩm và thương hiệu bảng giá' pulls a third, distinct set (M&M Communications combo packages, Haravan/DU Agency bundle listing) — confirming a genuine 'combo/bundle' search intent exists, but it is its OWN cluster, not a merge of the other two.
cannibalization_findings.recommendation: Do not merge /photography-video and /product-photography (real, distinct SERP intents per the sampling above). Instead: (1) re-scope /product-photography's own title/H1/meta to drop video-production language and own only 'chụp ảnh sản phẩm và thương hiệu' (photography-only), (2) keep /media-pricing strictly as the shared Level-4 commercial pricing hub that both Money Pages link OUT to (not a keyword-owning page itself — target only 'bảng giá quay chụp' + 'bảng giá sản xuất video', which is genuinely distinct commercial-investigation intent), (3) rewrite blog post #13 to a process/checklist angle ('Quy trình chụp ảnh sản phẩm chuyên nghiệp: từng bước') instead of a service pitch, or fold it into /product-photography as on-page content and 410/redirect the post, (4) retitle blog post #1 as an explicit comparison spoke ('Chụp ảnh hay quay video sản phẩm: nên chọn gì?') that legitimately links to both pillars instead of vaguely covering both.

competing_urls: news:"Dịch vụ Chatbot AI thông minh cho doanh nghiệp"
cannibalization_findings.keyword_overlap: chatbot ai cho doanh nghiệp / chatbot ai cho fanpage
cannibalization_findings.root_cause: The only blog post in this topic space is titled and framed exactly like a second Money Page ('Dịch vụ Chatbot AI thông minh cho doanh nghiệp'), duplicating /chatbox-ai's own primary keyword ('chatbot ai cho fanpage') with no differentiated informational angle.
cannibalization_findings.recommendation: Rewrite as a genuine TOFU/MOFU spoke (e.g. 'Chatbot AI Zalo OA vs Fanpage: nên chọn nền tảng nào?' or 'Chatbot AI trả lời sai bao nhiêu % thì cần con người tiếp quản?') that links down-funnel to /chatbox-ai rather than restating it.

cannibalization_findings.root_cause: Service-pitch blog post restates /digital-marketing's owned keyword and framing almost verbatim.
cannibalization_findings.recommendation: Retarget the post to a specific fanned-out sub-query per Playbook §23 query fan-out (e.g. budget allocation across Google/Meta/TikTok, or a channel-selection framework) and link down-funnel to /digital-marketing.

competing_urls: news:"Dịch vụ xây dựng Facebook Fanpage chuyên nghiệp: Không chỉ đẹp mà còn phải tạo ra khách hàng"
cannibalization_findings.root_cause: Same service-pitch pattern as CANN-02/03, one level down in priority since /fanpage-management is a lower commercial-priority Money Page per Playbook §8.
cannibalization_findings.recommendation: Same fix pattern — retarget to a specific angle (fanpage content pillar structure, or a 'trước/sau' fanpage audit format) rather than restating the service.

competing_urls: news:"Dịch vụ thiết kế website chuẩn UI/UX và SEO: Đẹp, dễ dùng và tạo khách hàng"
cannibalization_findings.root_cause: Same service-pitch pattern, but severity is lower here because this cluster otherwise has 9+ genuinely differentiated informational posts (Core Web Vitals, URL structure, information architecture, hero sections, search-intent checklist) that already interlink well and dilute the single duplicate post's practical ranking impact.
cannibalization_findings.recommendation: Lowest-priority fix of the five — retarget to a pricing/'what's included' commercial-investigation angle (Level 4 per Playbook §6) distinct from the Money Page's own transactional framing.

competing_urls: news:"Dịch vụ Marketing Spa trọn gói"
cannibalization_findings.keyword_overlap: marketing spa trọn gói (vertical-specific, no exact Money Page match today)
cannibalization_findings.root_cause: Not a direct duplicate — no Money Page targets the Spa vertical specifically — but it sits ambiguously between /digital-marketing and /fanpage-management with no relatedServices-style link to either.
cannibalization_findings.recommendation: Not urgent. If Unitrux wants a repeatable vertical-landing pattern (Spa, F&B, etc.), formalize it as an intentional Level-4 vertical spoke that links to both parent Money Pages; otherwise leave as-is but add the two missing internal links.
